title: A web app starter kit built for the long run
description: The application can replace the starter's entire design. How should the starter be architected to remain useful and keep delivering improvements to that different product?
thesis: Let the application become its own product.

explorer.title: A different product. Still a useful foundation.
explorer.instruction: Explore how the starter can support downstream freedom.
explorer.caption: Keep useful capabilities without keeping the default product design. Tooling preserves application choices; agent experiments test the separation.
